title: Dominant Zeros of Nekrasov--Okounkov Polynomials
authors: with an appendix by Ken Ono
summary: We give an exact finite-dimensional Perron--Frobenius realization of the dominant zero of the Nekrasov--Okounkov polynomials $\nop _n(z)$. For a normalized positive sequence $h=(h(n))_{n\ge 1}$ with $h(1)=1$, define $\pol _0^h(z)=1$ and, for $n\ge 1$, \[ \pol _n^h(z)=\frac{z}{h(n)}\sum_{k=1}^n σ(k)\pol _{n-k}^h(z),\] where $σ(k)$ denotes the sum of divisors of $k$. The Nekrasov--Okounkov polynomials are obtained from the specialization $h(n)=n$ by the shift $\nop _n(z)=\pol _n^h(z+1)$. We derive a Hessenberg determinant representation for $\pol _n^h(z)$.
